scope: Root and identity homepage entry routes; individual catalogue products are unassessed.

levels.label: Unassessed
levels.meaning: No scoped assurance assessment is recorded.

levels.label: Scoped
levels.meaning: Purpose, coverage and evidence obligations are declared.

levels.label: Mechanically checked
levels.meaning: The required automated checks pass within that stated scope.

levels.label: Human reviewed
levels.meaning: A dated, attributed review addresses the remaining judgment-dependent obligations.

levels.label: Experienced in use
levels.meaning: Relevant people have exercised representative journeys and the findings are recorded.

levels.label: Maintained
levels.meaning: Ownership, reassessment and regression evidence support continued assurance.

topics.title: Identity & world coherence
topics.description: The first worked example: declared identity intent, generated mappings, discovery and open relationships.

topics.title: Accessibility
topics.description: The second worked example: selected markup evidence, human evaluation and accessible journeys in use.

topics.title: Internationalisation
topics.description: An independent saga for locale policy, localisable content, language review and locale journeys.

sagas.title: Identity & world coherence
sagas.scope: Identity assignments and generated entry journeys across the root and four identity homepages.

gates.label: Scope and intent
gates.next: Record the identities, coverage and limits of the identity assessment.

gates.label: Declared mappings and discovery
gates.next: Keep declared mappings complete and retain undeclared observations as open work.

evidence.method: Current identity mapping and discovery reports; undecided groups remain open work.

gates.label: Semantic and visual review
gates.next: Review the world assignments and discovered groups; record reviewer, method, source and date.

gates.label: Reading journeys in use
gates.next: Observe readers following representative identity journeys and record the findings.

gates.label: Ongoing ownership
gates.next: Assign an owner and record reassessment, regression coverage and evidence freshness.

sagas.boundary: Levels describe the maturity of evidence within this scope. Receipt metadata is checked; authenticity, evaluation quality and broader product readiness require their own review.

sagas.title: Accessibility
sagas.scope: Selected homepage markup checks across five entry routes. Human keyboard, assistive-technology, reflow and visual evaluation remain open.

gates.label: Scope of accessibility evaluation
gates.next: Declare the routes and the limited markup checks being evaluated.

gates.label: Document language markers
gates.next: Keep a nonempty language marker on every assessed homepage.

evidence.method: Current generated entry markup; presence checks only.

gates.label: Skip-link target
gates.next: Keep a #main link and its main target on every assessed homepage.

evidence.method: Current generated entry markup; presence checks only.

gates.label: Image alternative attributes
gates.next: Keep an alt attribute on every observed image; review its meaning separately.

evidence.method: Current generated entry markup; presence checks only.

gates.label: Human accessibility evaluation
gates.next: Evaluate keyboard and focus journeys, screen-reader use, zoom/reflow and visual contrast; record findings and coverage.

gates.label: Journeys with disabled participants
gates.next: Observe representative tasks with people with disabilities and record barriers and resolution.

gates.label: Accessibility maintenance
gates.next: Assign ownership, review cadence and regression evidence for the assessed journeys.

sagas.boundary: Levels describe the maturity of evidence within this scope. Receipt metadata is checked; authenticity, evaluation quality and broader product readiness require their own review.

sagas.title: Internationalisation
sagas.scope: Readiness of the currently English homepage entry routes for localisation. Target audiences, supported locales and fallback policy remain undecided.

gates.label: Scope of internationalisation assessment
gates.next: Record the current English baseline and the unresolved locale requirements.

gates.label: Language and UTF-8 metadata
gates.next: Keep explicit document language and UTF-8 encoding markers on assessed routes.

evidence.method: Current generated entry markup; presence checks only.

gates.label: Locale and fallback policy
gates.next: Choose target audiences, supported locales, defaults and fallback behaviour before claiming readiness.

gates.label: Localisable content evidence
gates.next: Assess message and content externalisation and supply evidence of locale selection and fallback.

gates.label: Locale behaviour evidence
gates.next: Exercise locale-sensitive numbers, dates, names, text expansion and text direction as applicable.

gates.label: Language and cultural review
gates.next: Record linguistic, cultural and typographic review for each promised locale.

gates.label: Locale journeys in use
gates.next: Observe representative journeys with the intended language and locale audiences.

gates.label: Localisation maintenance
gates.next: Assign ownership and record translation freshness, fallback and locale regression coverage.

sagas.boundary: Levels describe the maturity of evidence within this scope. Receipt metadata is checked; authenticity, evaluation quality and broader product readiness require their own review.

boundary: Evidence maturity is scoped by product and saga. Catalogue delivery labels do not supply assurance. No composite product score is calculated. These levels are separate from WCAG conformance or promised locale support. Higher-level review, use and maintenance receipts are not supplied by this release.
